compose_land_constraint_constellation.problem: (compose as_of 2026-09-22) /land research reads as a flat list. L-05 v2 reasoning entries, L-11 constraint cards, L-12 day-board conditionals/candidates and /land/s/power §2 [VERIFY] items reference each other, but those binding relations can't be seen or followed. Need: a read-only, lazy print-sky overlay on /land. Stars are existing plate ids. Edges are only the cites / falsifies / shares-placeholder relations already written in the sources. No new assets, no new plates (no L-16+), no trading surface. The L-05 v2 and L-01 河 PASTEs remain binding by reference.
do: Mount as an overlay inside /land, opened by the 「仰望 / Look up」 toggle and closed by 「低头 / Look down」 or Esc. /land keeps its scroll position and focus returns to the toggle.

Build stars from the existing id index of L-05 v2 entries, L-11 cards, L-12 candidates and power §2 [VERIFY] items. Copy id, grade and as_of byte-for-byte. Unresolved refs go to manifest.excluded[] with a reason and show in a footer count 「未解析 n / Unresolved n」. They are never patched.

Take edges only from explicit source text. An id mention gives cites. An explicit falsifying marker gives falsifies. The same Grade S placeholder token on two stars gives shares_placeholder. Every cites or falsifies edge stores provenance {plate, anchor}.
Group stars into 4 named constellations by plate: 系缚座 The Tether (L-11), 岔路座 The Fork (L-12), 未明座 The Unproven (power§2) and 星历座 The Ephemeris (L-05).

Focus or click a star to open the side plate 「星签 / Star tag」. It shows exactly id, plate, grade, as_of, the standing notice, typed edge rows (zh+en), a same-origin source-plate anchor, and the refuse line (Q-* only).
Offer 3 lenses: T 循引 Trace, F 反证镜 Falsify lens and P 同空 Twin placeholders. They re-light existing edges only and never add or infer an edge.

Give Q-* stars a ⊘ marker and the zh+en refuse line (copy ui.q_refuse) inside [data-refuse-list]; the legend's marker.Q row also renders inside [data-refuse-list]. Q-* side-plate controls are limited to the same-origin source link and in-sky edge-focus buttons: 0 inputs, 0 outbound calls.
Ship a lazy chunk `land-constellation` plus a same-origin manifest, fetched only after 「仰望 / Look up」 or a #sky= deep link.
Compute the layout deterministically at build: position = f(sha256(id)) inside the plate's sector (L-05 included), then a collision pass over ids sorted by id. Identical input gives an identical sky.
Provide a 「星表 / Catalogue」 text view holding the same stars, grades, as_of values and edges. It serves screen readers and the print appendix and adds nothing.
Ship every user-facing string from copy in zh+en, and reuse the existing /land standing notice verbatim.
dont: No star that is absent verbatim from a source plate: no sample, demo, FIXTURE-, ticker or instrument nodes.
No 4th edge type, and no similarity, co-occurrence, model-made, weighted or hand-guessed edges.
No price, PnL, order, quote, LIVE, tips, 必赚, 10000x or buy/sell wording, nor position/return in a holding/yield sense, in any text, aria-label, title, tooltip or print.
Placement, size and brightness encode nothing: no axes, no time or value mapping, no ranking glow, no 'hot' stars.
No force/physics layout, runtime randomness, idle twinkle, drift, parallax, auto-tour, automatic pan or looping motion.
No hues beyond the navy, gold and ink/paper tokens, and no red/green up/down semantics.
Never set a default grade or as_of, never re-grade, and never assign meaning to O/M/S/C beyond 'S = placeholder'.
No API-key field, exchange login/OAuth, wallet connect, order ticket or exchange deep link, for Q-* or any other star.
No market data, websocket or third-party request. connect-src 'self'.
No writes: no plate edit, no L-05 log append and no verify_clear mint from the overlay.
Keep the chunk and manifest out of the homepage bundle: no import, prefetch, preload or modulepreload.
No L-16+ plate, id or reserved slot.
Do not touch /field, /campus or /ethics: no files, links, stars or edges.
Do not restate, paraphrase or override the L-05 v2 or L-01 河 PASTE.

metaphor.zh: 研究是一片被约束绑住的天空：每颗星是既有版面 id，每条线是原文已写明的关系。星图，不是清单。
metaphor.en: Research as a sky of binding constraints: every star is an existing plate id, every line a relation already written in the source. A star chart, not a list.

sky.tokens: --gv-navy / --gv-gold / --gv-ink / --gv-paper are placeholder names: map each to the existing /land navy, gold, ink and paper tokens; create none.
sky.field: Full-bleed navy token inside the overlay. There is one hairline horizon arc and no graticule, axes or glow. Each constellation boundary is a single dotted gold@30 hairline, captioned in ink with its name in zh+en.

constellations.region: 天心 centre sector (placement only, no rank)
西弧 west-arc sector; each star carries a small [ ] tick mirroring its source [VERIFY] tag
地平带 horizon-band sector; placed by id hash, not by time

sky.dots: Every star is the same-radius filled gold token dot at fill-opacity 0.30, Grade S included. Grade S adds an ink hairline outer ring (placeholder) with fill unchanged. The grade letter appears as an ink superscript. Q-* stars get a ⊘ ring. The focused star gets a 2px ink focus ring.
sky.labels: Verbatim id in ink on a paper-token tag, mono 11px, print-dense, never truncated into another id. Label contrast is at least 4.5:1 against the tag.

edges.cites: Solid hairline with an arrow toward the cited star.
edges.falsifies: Dashed hairline with a ⊣ bar at the falsified star.
edges.shares_placeholder: Dotted hairline, undirected, with a hollow ◌ midpoint.
edges.label: Every edge element carries a zh+en accessible name from the copy.legend edge entries: '<from> 引用 cites <to>' / '<from> 证伪 falsifies <to>' / '<a> 共用占位 shares placeholder <b>'.
edges.focus_state: Edges incident to the focused star turn ink and show a zh+en type chip. Everything else stays gold@30.

sky.asterism: 空心星群 Hollow asterism: ringed S stars joined by shares_placeholder read as one figure, meaning one missing source would fill them all. It is visible under lens P and never ranked.
sky.layout: Fixed viewBox with 4 sectors. x,y = f(sha256(id)) within the plate's sector, L-05 included. A collision pass runs over ids sorted by id, and the earlier id keeps its slot. Everything is computed at build, with no runtime physics.
sky.motion: Sparse. A one-shot incident-edge draw-in of 240ms or less on focus. Nothing idles or loops; no automatic pan.
sky.reduced_motion: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce means 0 animations and 0 transitions. State changes are instant and the output is identical to the static SVG.
sky.print: @media print: paper ground, ink stars and hairlines, gold rendered as ink outlines. The legend and Catalogue are appended, and the standing notice appears on every page.
sky.mobile: User-driven scroll/pan only inside the sky frame, with no horizontal page scroll and no animated or inertial pan under reduced motion. The side plate becomes a bottom sheet.
sky.loading: A toggle- or hash-triggered dynamic import (never on /land load without #sky=) loads chunk `land-constellation` and fetches manifest {schema:'constellation/1', as_of, source_sha{L-05,L-11,L-12,power§2}, stars[], edges[{from,to,type,provenance}], excluded[{ref,reason}]}. No graph, physics, animation or charting library.
sky.empty: With no resolvable ids, the sky shows the horizon arc and copy.empty_sky centred. No stars are drawn.
sky.inherits: The L-05 v2 and L-01 河 PASTEs remain binding by reference. The sky restates neither.

interaction.open_close: The toggle (aria-expanded) or deep link /land#sky=<id> opens a role=dialog aria-modal overlay. Esc unpins the star first, a second Esc closes the overlay, and focus returns to the toggle.
interaction.focus_model: The sky is one tab stop with a roving tabindex. Each star's accessible name is '<id> · <plate> · 等级 grade <g or —>'. Focus changes are announced through role=status using copy ui.status_focus (zh+en).

keys.ArrowLeft/ArrowRight: Previous/next star in the constellation (by id; L-05 by append sequence where L-05 v2 records one, else by id)
keys.ArrowUp/ArrowDown: Cycle constellations: Tether, Fork, Unlit, Ephemeris
keys.Enter/Space: Pin or unpin the side plate
keys.E / Shift+E: Follow the next/previous incident edge to its neighbour
keys.T / F / P: Toggle the Trace / Falsify lens / Twin placeholders lens

interaction.key_help: This key table is spec only; on-screen key help renders solely from copy.legend keys (zh+en).
interaction.pointer: Hover shows only the id + plate tag. Click focuses and pins a star. Clicking the empty field unpins.

fields: grade letter verbatim, or '— 未标 / not recorded'; S adds '占位 / placeholder'
as_of verbatim, or '未注明 / not stated'
standing notice [data-notice]: existing /land component verbatim, with copy notice.fallback only if none exists
edge rows: type zh+en → neighbour id, each a button that moves focus there
「打开原版面 / Open source plate」: same-origin plate anchor
refuse line (Q-* only): copy ui.q_refuse inside [data-refuse-list]
side_plate.placement: Right rail at 900px and wider, bottom sheet below that.
side_plate.never: No field absent from the source plate. No inputs or forms.

does.zh: 点亮所选星上下游完整引用链；其余图层组透明度降至 0.3，星本身填充不变。
does.en: Lights the full cites chain upstream and downstream of the focused star; other layers drop to group opacity 0.3, star fill-opacity unchanged.

does.zh: 只显示触及所选星的证伪连线：何者可推翻它，它可推翻何者。
does.en: Shows only falsifies edges touching the focused star: what could overturn it, and what it could overturn.

does.zh: 只显示共用占位连线；空心星群显现，每缺一处来源一组。
does.en: Shows only shares_placeholder edges; hollow asterisms appear, one per missing source.

interaction.filters: Toggle chips for each constellation and each edge type, labelled from copy.legend. They hide or show layers without moving any star. State lives in the URL hash (#sky=&plates=&edges=).
interaction.deep_link_miss: An unknown id opens the sky unfocused with the status line copy ui.deep_link_miss. No substitute star is shown.

q_star.rule: A star whose id starts with Q- shows copy ui.q_refuse inside [data-refuse-list]. Its side-plate controls are limited to the same-origin source link and in-sky edge-focus buttons: 0 inputs, 0 outbound calls.

interaction.catalogue: 「星表 / Catalogue」 is a grouped table with headers from copy ui.catalogue (星座 constellation · id · 等级 grade · as_of · 连线 edges), rows by id (L-05 by append sequence where recorded). It carries the same N stars as the sky and is not the default view.
interaction.read_only: Opening, focusing, lenses, filters and close perform 0 writes to any plate, the L-05 log or storage beyond the URL hash.

acceptance: [data] The set difference between manifest star ids and the source id indexes is empty. plate is one of {L-05, L-11, L-12, power§2}. drawn + excluded = refs scanned. FIXTURE- ids in a shipped manifest = 0.
[scope] The pattern L-(1[6-9]|[2-9][0-9]|[0-9]{3,}) has 0 hits over the manifest, chunk and copy. CI path guard: 0 changed files under /field, /campus or /ethics, and 0 links to them.

[edges] type is one of {cites, falsifies, shares_placeholder}. Both endpoints are stars. No self-loops. shares_placeholder is stored canonically with from < to by id; no duplicate (from,to,type). Each cites/falsifies provenance resolves to a source span containing the target id. shares_placeholder endpoints share at least one Grade S placeholder token. Inferred edges = 0. 100% of edge elements carry a zh+en accessible name whose type label matches one of the 3 legend entries.

[parity] Rendered grade and as_of are byte-equal to the source for 100% of stars. A missing value renders the zh+en 'not recorded / not stated' copy and is never defaulted. At rest (no lens), all star radii and fill-opacities are equal, Grade S included.

[dom] Every focused star's side plate contains exactly {id, plate, grade, as_of, standing notice, edge rows, source link}, plus the refuse line if and only if the id starts with Q-. The overlay has 0 input/form/select/textarea elements.

[lint] Case-insensitive whole-word scan for price, pnl, order, live, tips, buy, sell, plus substrings 必赚, 10000x, 价格, 盈亏, 下单, 订单, 买入, 卖出, over rendered textContent, aria-label, title, role=status output and print: 0 hits. A currency symbol followed by a digit: 0 hits. Every rendered string (ids, grade letters and the reused /land standing notice verbatim excepted) resolves to a copy key with non-empty zh and en.

[q] Q-<placeholder> fixture (Grade S): ⊘ marker and copy ui.q_refuse (zh+en) present inside [data-refuse-list]. Case-insensitive whole-word scan of the Q-* star's side plate and its sky subtree, excluding [data-refuse-list] and [data-notice]: 0 matches for key, keys, 密钥, login, 登录, wallet, 钱包, exchange, 交易所. Controls = source link + edge-focus buttons only; 0 input/password fields; 0 requests beyond the land-constellation chunk and 1 same-origin manifest; 0 storage writes.

[network] GET / makes 0 requests matching 'constellation'. /land without #sky= makes 0 before the toggle; after the toggle, or on load with #sky=, there is exactly the chunk + 1 manifest, both same-origin. 0 cross-origin requests or websockets at any point. CSP connect-src 'self'.

[bundle] The homepage entry graph has 0 modules under land/constellation/**. Homepage and /land shell HTML have 0 prefetch/preload/modulepreload refs to the chunk or manifest. The dependency scan finds no graph/physics/animation/charting, wallet or exchange SDK.
[determinism] Two builds, including one with shuffled source input, give identical manifest sha256 and SVG bytes.

[motion] Under reducedMotion='reduce': document.getAnimations() is empty, transition-duration is 0s, and screenshots 50ms and 500ms after focus are pixel-identical. By default: 0 infinite animations, 0 automatic pans, and nothing moves more than 240ms after a focus change.

[style] Computed field = navy token. Every star fill = gold token at fill-opacity 0.3 at rest; S adds only an ink hairline ring. Labels = ink on paper token. Tokens map to existing /land navy/gold/ink/paper tokens; 0 new tokens; no other hue.

[a11y] axe-core reports 0 serious/critical issues. ArrowLeft/Right visit each star of a constellation exactly once. ArrowUp/Down reach all 4. E walks the incident edges. Esc then Esc returns focus to the toggle. The Catalogue lists the same N stars.
[empty] With 0 resolvable ids, empty_sky renders in zh+en with 0 star nodes.
[read-only] A session of open, focus, T/F/P, filter and close produces 0 plate writes, 0 L-05 appends and 0 verify_clear events.
[print] Print emulation shows a static ink-on-paper sky, the legend, the Catalogue appendix and the standing notice on every page.
[inherit] Reviewer check: the overlay cites the L-05 v2 and L-01 河 PASTEs as inherited, does not restate them and does not conflict with them.

star_schema.id: string. The existing plate id, copied verbatim from its source id index (<L-05 entry id> | <L-11 card id> | <L-12 candidate id> | <power §2 VERIFY id>). It must resolve on its plate or the star is not drawn. It is unique within the sky and never minted or normalized. A leading Q- takes the refuse-list path. FIXTURE- ids are rejected in shipped manifests.
star_schema.plate: enum 'L-05' | 'L-11' | 'L-12' | 'power§2' (= /land/s/power §2). It selects the constellation. Any other value, including L-16+, fails the build.
star_schema.grade: enum 'O' | 'M' | 'S' | 'C' | null. Copied byte-for-byte from the source plate; the existing meaning is unchanged and not redefined here. S = placeholder (extra ink hairline ring, fill unchanged). null renders as '— 未标 / not recorded' and is never defaulted or inferred.

legend.zh: 引用 —— 实线箭头：此星原文点名引用彼星
legend.en: cites —— solid arrow: this star's source names that star

legend.zh: 证伪 ─ ─ 虚线，末端 ⊣：此星记载可推翻彼星的条件
legend.en: falsifies ─ ─ dashed, ⊣ at target: this star records a condition that would overturn that star

legend.zh: 共用占位 ··· 点线，无方向，中点空心 ◌：两星共用同一 S 级占位，一处来源可同时填实
legend.en: shares placeholder ··· dotted, undirected, hollow ◌ midpoint: both stars hold the same Grade S placeholder, and one source fills both

legend.zh: 系缚座 · L-11 约束卡 · 天心
legend.en: The Tether · L-11 constraint cards · centre

legend.zh: 岔路座 · L-12 日板条件·候选 · 东弧
legend.en: The Fork · L-12 day-board conditionals · candidates · east arc

legend.zh: 未明座 · /land/s/power §2 [VERIFY] 项 · 西弧
legend.en: The Unproven · /land/s/power §2 [VERIFY] items · west arc

legend.zh: 星历座 · L-05 推理日志条目 · 地平带
legend.en: The Ephemeris · L-05 reasoning-log entries · horizon band

legend.zh: 等级 O · M · S · C —— 照录来源版面，本页不重定义、不重评
legend.en: Grade O · M · S · C —— copied from the source plate; never redefined or re-graded here

legend.zh: S —— 占位，外加细环
legend.en: S —— placeholder, extra hairline ring

legend.zh: — 来源未标等级，不补
legend.en: — no grade on the source; none filled in

legend.zh: as_of —— 取自来源条目；未写则显示「未注明」
legend.en: as_of —— from the source entry; shows 'not stated' when absent

legend.zh: ⊘ Q-* 量化星：拒绝清单生效 · 无密钥 · 无交易所登录 · 无钱包连接 · 无交易入口
legend.en: ⊘ Q-* quant star: refuse-list applies · no keys · no exchange login · no wallet connect · no trade entry

legend.zh: 空心星群 —— 多颗带环 S 星以同一占位相连：缺的是同一处来源
legend.en: Hollow asterism —— ringed S stars joined by one placeholder: they lack the same single source

legend.zh: 星位、大小、亮度均不表示数值、时间或排名
legend.en: Star placement, size and brightness encode no value, time or rank

legend.zh: T 循引 · F 反证镜 · P 同空 —— 只重亮既有连线
legend.en: T Trace · F Falsify lens · P Twin placeholders —— re-light existing lines only

legend.zh: ←/→ 同座移动 · ↑/↓ 换星座 · Home 回系缚座 · E 沿边 · Enter 固定 · C 星表 · Esc 取消固定，再按收起
legend.en: ←/→ within constellation · ↑/↓ switch constellation · Home back to The Tether · E follow edge · Enter pin · C catalogue · Esc unpin, again to close

legend.zh: 未解析 n —— 在原版面找不到的 id 不上天
legend.en: Unresolved n —— ids not found on their plate are not drawn

legend.zh: 常设声明（后备）：仅供研究；非投资建议；本星图只读，不执行任何操作。
legend.en: Standing notice (fallback): research only; not investment advice; this sky is read-only and executes nothing.

legend.zh: 已开启「减少动态」：星空完全静止
legend.en: Reduced motion on: the sky is fully static

legend.zh: 仰望 · 低头
legend.en: Look up · Look down

legend.zh: 星签
legend.en: Star tag

legend.zh: 打开原版面
legend.en: Open source plate

legend.zh: — 未标 · 未注明
legend.en: — not recorded · not stated

legend.zh: 星表 —— 星座 · id · 等级 · as_of · 连线
legend.en: Catalogue —— constellation · id · grade · as_of · edges

legend.zh: 该 id 不在当前星图
legend.en: id not in current sky

legend.zh: 已聚焦 <id> · <plate> · 等级 <g 或 —>
legend.en: Focused <id> · <plate> · grade <g or —>

legend.zh: Q-* 量化拒绝清单生效：无密钥 · 无交易所登录 · 无钱包连接 · 无交易入口。
legend.en: Q-* quant refuse-list applies: no keys · no exchange login · no wallet connect · no trade entry.

empty_sky.zh: 今夜无星。L-05、L-11、L-12 与 power §2 暂无可解析的 id —— 这片天空不会替你编造星辰。
empty_sky.en: No stars tonight. L-05, L-11, L-12 and power §2 have no resolvable ids yet —— this sky will not invent any.

dont_repeat: Don't repeat: shipping sample or demo stars 'until real data lands'. The empty sky is the honest state.
Don't repeat: letting a layout heuristic (similarity, co-occurrence) quietly become a 4th edge type.
Don't repeat: size, glow or position hinting at importance. Every star is equal.
Don't repeat: filling a missing grade with S or a missing as_of with the build date.
Don't repeat: a banned word (price, PnL, order, LIVE, tips, 必赚, 10000x, buy/sell) slipping in through aria-labels, tooltips or print.
Don't repeat: a Q-* star exposing any input, key field, exchange or wallet button.
Don't repeat: shared-chunk hoisting or prefetch dragging the constellation into the homepage bundle.
Don't repeat: ambient loops that ignore prefers-reduced-motion.
Don't repeat: overlays that 'helpfully' write back (log appends, verify_clear) from a read-only view.
Don't repeat: scope creep into L-16+, /field, /campus or /ethics, or restating the L-05 / L-01 河 PASTE instead of inheriting it.
open_questions: Provenance: do L-11, L-12 and power §2 already carry explicit cross-id refs, and which marker means 'falsifies' rather than a plain citation? Until the founder defines it, falsifies edges stay empty rather than inferred.
L-01 河 PASTE is still binding. Should it render as a faint, starless, unlabeled 天河 band (decor only), or stay absent because the LOCKED star sources exclude L-01?
